entities.name: Martí Gasull i Roig
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Martí Gasull i Roig was a Catalan linguistic activist and a mountaineer, one of the founders of the Platform for the Catalan Language. He was fully involved in the organisation's coordination, becoming its ideologist. He combined his love for the Catalan language and culture with his great passion for mountaineering. On 23 September 2012, he died in an accident on Manaslu in Nepal. Martí Gasull i Roig work’s has been appreciated many times. The Government of Catalonia posthumously awarded him the Cross of St George on 9 October 2012.
